name: bingers
description: Track shows and movies with Bingers: see where you are in every show, get picks you haven't seen yet, and mark episodes and movies watched as you go.

interface.longDescription:
Bingers is the app that keeps track of every show and movie you watch. Connect it and your assistant knows your library too.

Ask what to watch tonight and get picks that skip everything you've already seen. Ask which shows you're behind on and when the next episodes air. Finish an episode, say so, and it's marked watched, with a rating if you like. You can also follow new shows, save things for later, check your favorites and your lists, and find titles similar to one you loved.

Your assistant only sees your Bingers library and our catalog, and only after you approve it. It never sees your other apps, and Bingers never sees your conversation. You can choose read only when you connect, and disconnect anytime.

You'll need a Bingers account: get the app for iPhone or Android at bingers.app.

positive.description: Recommend something unseen that is similar to a show the user names.
positive.prompt: What should I watch tonight? Something like Severance that I haven't seen.
positive.expected_behavior: A few titles not in the library, with a reason each.

positive.description: List the shows the user is behind on.
positive.prompt: Which shows am I behind on?
positive.expected_behavior: The watch-next and collecting-dust shows with the next episode for each.

positive.description: Find when the next episode of a show airs.
positive.prompt: When does the next episode of The Bear air?
positive.expected_behavior: The date, or that the season has finished.

positive.description: Mark an episode watched with a rating.
positive.prompt: Mark Shogun season 1 episode 1 as watched and rate it 5 stars.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirmation naming the show and episode.

positive.description: Check which of several titles the user has already seen.
positive.prompt: Which of these have I seen: The Wire, Dark, Mindhunter?
